```{r, include=FALSE}
# datetime->date & time

# renaming columns to change
names(calls) [6] <- "response_datetime" 
names(calls) [11] <- "arrived_datetime"
names(calls) [12] <- "closed_datetime"


# breaking columns by index
calls <- calls %>%
  mutate(response_time = str_sub(response_datetime,12,23),
         response_date = str_sub(response_datetime,1,11),
         arrived_time = str_sub(arrived_datetime,12,23),
         arrived_date = str_sub(arrived_datetime,1,11),
         closed_time = str_sub(closed_datetime,12,23),
         closed_date = str_sub(closed_datetime,1,11),
         initiator = case_when(
                `Incident Type` == "Officer-Initiated Incident" ~ "Officer",
                `Incident Type` == "Dispatched Incident" ~ "Citizen",
                TRUE ~ NA_character_)
        )

# checking my work
head(calls$response_time)
head(calls$response_date)
head(calls$arrived_time)
head(calls$arrived_date)
head(calls$closed_time)
head(calls$closed_date)

head(calls)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Call Type Classification
calls_sorted <- calls %>%
  mutate(
    calls_disorder = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Disturbance", "Disorderly Conduct", "Property Damage/Vandalism", "Drugs", "Prositution")),
    calls_behavior = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Suspicious Things", "Trespassing")),
    calls_traffic = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Crashes"),
    calls_gun = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Shoot/Stab", "Weapons/Firearms Violations")),
         
        calls_robbery = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Robbery"),
        calls_aggravated_assault = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Aggravated Assault"),
        calls_burglary = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Burglary"),
        calls_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Theft"),
        calls_mv_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Auto Theft"),
  
            calls_violent = calls_robbery + calls_aggravated_assault,
            calls_property = calls_burglary + calls_theft + calls_mv_theft,
            calls_index = calls_violent + calls_property,
    
              initiator = case_when(
                `Incident Type` == "Officer-Initiated Incident" ~ "Officer",
                `Incident Type` == "Dispatched Incident" ~ "Citizen",
                TRUE ~ NA_character_
          
              )
)
```

```{r}
# day-year
by_day <- calls %>%
  mutate(
    date_response = as_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
    ) %>%
      count(date_response, initiator) %>%
      rename(day = date_response)
  
ggplot(by_day, aes(day, n, color = initiator, group = initiator)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~initiator, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Timeline and Initiator", x = "Day", y = "Calls") 

```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
by_month <- calls_sorted %>% 
  mutate (
    month_response = floor_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime), "month"),
    month_arrived = floor_date(mdy_hms(arrived_datetime), "month"),
    month_closed = floor_date(mdy_hms(closed_datetime), "month")
  )
  
  
by_month_type <- bind_rows(
  by_month %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_month %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  by_month %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(month = month_response, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
)

by_month_type_proportional <- by_month_type %>%
  group_by(initiator, type) %>%
  mutate(proportional = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(by_month_type_proportional, aes(month, proportional, color = initiator, group = initiator)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Month, Type, and Initiator (Cleaned)", x = "Month", y = "Calls*") +
  theme_minimal() 
  
```

```{r, fig.width = 20}
by_time <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
         day_of_week = wday(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
         )

heatmap_by_type <- bind_rows(
  by_time %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_time %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  by_time %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(day_of_week, hour, initiator) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
)


ggplot(heatmap_by_type %>% filter(initiator == "Citizen"), 
       aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Officer Call Volume Heatmap by Day and Hour", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "Total Calls") 


ggplot(heatmap_by_type %>% filter(initiator == "Officer"),
       aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Citizen Call Volume Heatmap by Day and Hour", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "Total Calls") 




# By percent so we can see the smaller types
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#Information needed 


df_dates <- expand.grid(year = 2014:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>% 

  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>% 

  mutate(date = ymd(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% 

  arrange(date) 

 df_dates

#Get suntime data 


df_sun <- df_dates %>% 

  mutate(lat = 30.267118,  

         lon = -97.743130) %>% 

  getSunlightTimes(data = ., tz = "America/Chicago", keep = c("dawn", "sunrise", "sunset", "dusk", "night")) %>% 

  rename_all(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    dawn = hour(dawn) + minute(dawn) / 60,
    sunrise = hour(sunrise) + minute(sunrise) / 60,
    sunset = hour(sunset) + minute(sunset) / 60,
    dusk = hour(dusk) + minute(dusk) / 60,
    night = hour(night) + minute(night) / 60
  )

df_sun

```

```{r}
plottheme <- theme( 
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12), 
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"), 
  panel.background = element_blank(),  
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
  legend.key = element_rect(colour = "transparent", fill = "transparent"), 
  legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), 
  legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.position = "none", 
  rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )


dst_dates <- tibble(
  year = 2014:2024,
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)

calls_night <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(substr(response_datetime, 1, 10), format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    time_parsed = strptime(response_time, format = "%I:%M:%S %p"),
    hour_dec = hour(time_parsed) + minute(time_parsed) / 60 + second(time_parsed) / 3600
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_sun, by = "date") %>%
  filter(hour_dec >= sunset & hour_dec < night)

calls_sorted_night <- calls_night %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(starts_with("calls_")), sum, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

dst_rd_spring <- calls_sorted_night %>%
  mutate( 
    year = year(date)
    ) %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(days_until_spring = as.integer(date - dst_spring)) %>%
  filter(days_until_spring %in% -21:21) %>%
  mutate(
    dst_on = if_else(days_until_spring >= 0, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  group_by(days_until_spring, dst_on) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(starts_with("calls_")), mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

vnames <- dst_rd_spring %>% select(starts_with("calls_")) %>% names()


for(X in vnames){ 

  f1 <- as.formula(paste0(X, "~ poly(days_until_spring, 2)")) 
  sub_no  <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "no")
  sub_yes <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "yes")

  if(length(unique(sub_no$days_until_spring)) < 3 | length(unique(sub_yes$days_until_spring)) < 3) next

  lm1 <- lm(f1, data = sub_no)
  lm2 <- lm(f1, data = sub_yes)
  pred1 <- predict(lm1, newdata = sub_no, se = TRUE)
  pred2 <- predict(lm2, newdata = sub_yes, se = TRUE)

  dst_rd_spring_plot <- bind_rows(sub_no, sub_yes) %>%
    mutate(pred = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit), 
           upper = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) - qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit), 
           lower = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) + qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit)) 

  clean_title <- X %>% 
    str_replace("calls_", "") %>% 
    str_replace("_", " ") %>% 
    str_to_title()
  
  ylabel <- ifelse(str_detect(X, "clearedrate"), "Clearance rate", "Crimes") 
  
p <- ggplot(dst_rd_spring_plot, aes(x = days_until_spring, y = .data[[X]])) + 
    geom_point(aes(group = dst_on), size = 3, color = "royalblue", shape = 1) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = pred, group = dst_on)) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = upper, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_line(aes(y = lower, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +  
    labs(title = paste("Austin 911 RD:", clean_title), 
         x = "Days until Spring DST starts", 
         y = ylabel)
print(p)
}


```
